snippet.title: Extinction of the Exaverse | Turn-Based Mobile Dungeon Crawler Trailer
snippet.description:
Dinosaurs fight AI robots in Extinction of the Exaverse, a tactical turn-based mobile dungeon crawler built for quick, one-handed runs on iOS and Android.

Mine GEMS, stack powerful Boons, collect gear, and find the portal before the machines close in. Every move changes the board and every run creates a new build.

Coming September 2026.

Join Early Access: https://discord.com/invite/exa-labs-1037877420658802789
Explore the game: https://exaverse.gg/

#MobileGaming #DungeonCrawler #Roguelite
